title: Change the business name or usage on a vehicle registration
summary: You can add, change, or delete a 'courtesy name' and/or change the usage details on your vehicle registration at a service centre.
intro:
You can add, change or delete a 'courtesy name', and/or change the usage details on your rego at a service centre.

A 'courtesy name' is a business name recorded on a vehicle's registration papers, where the registered operator is an individual.

The usage details are represented as a code, including, but not limited to:

Note: If you're only changing a courtesy name, or usage such as private, business or pensioner, you may be eligible to do so by calling 13 77 88.
what_you_need: your business details (if the vehicle is registered under a business)
a copy of the Certificate of Registration of Business Name as proof of identity for the business (if applicable)
